subject.title: fix(agents): xAI/Grok requests fail after a stale reasoning replay ("could not decrypt encrypted_content")

question: Should this PR receive a proof override for the xAI code-less decrypt error, given the contributor's claim that the provider-side rotation trigger cannot be induced on demand?
rationale: ClawSweeper's normal external-PR gate requires after-fix real behavior proof, but the visible discussion gives a concrete reason that a faithful live reproduction may require waiting for an organic xAI rotation event.

options.title: Accept a proof override
options.body: Allow maintainers to treat the pre-fix production logs, focused predicate tests, green CI, and existing one-shot retry path as sufficient for this narrow provider-error classifier change.

options.title: Wait for organic recovery logs
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until the contributor can attach redacted after-fix Grok/gateway logs from a real xAI rotation event.

options.title: Ask for a provider harness
options.body: Request an alternative live or provider-supported harness that can produce the same code-less xAI decrypt error without fabricating a different error path.

recommendation.title: Accept a proof override
recommendation.body: Allow maintainers to treat the pre-fix production logs, focused predicate tests, green CI, and existing one-shot retry path as sufficient for this narrow provider-error classifier change.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the xAI encrypted reasoning include behavior and are the best available owner in this review's history for the xAI-specific proof decision.
